title: The semantic layer and modelling for self-service

videos.script: Lesson two gave revenue one meaning. Now forty people want to build their own charts. {{people}} Each of them, clicking through a tool's menus, writes the definition again. One forgets the test account. One sums the gross value. Six months later there are nine revenues. {{nine}} The fix is a layer between the tables and the people. A handful of views, with business names, where every definition is already applied. {{layer}} You will build it as a star. Facts in the middle, the things you group by around them. {{star}} You will see the one join that quietly doubles a total, and why the layer makes it hard to write. {{fanout}} Then you will give a BI tool a login of its own, that can read the layer and nothing else. {{role}} And you will install Metabase on your machine, connect it, and ask for revenue by month without writing a line of SQL. {{metabase}} The answer for the first quarter is the same figure finance reached by hand, to the cent. {{end}}
